'use strict';
function assign(lock: (array: number[]) => void, next: number, startLocked: boolean) {
  const values = [1, 2];
  let calls = 0;
  if (startLocked) lock(values);
  const size = {
    valueOf() {
      calls++;
      if (calls === 2) lock(values);
      return next;
    },
  };
  try {
    values.length = size as any;
    console.log('assigned');
  } catch (error) {
    console.log((error as Error).message);
  }
  console.log(values.length, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(values, 'length')?.writable, calls);
}
function readonlyLength(values: number[]) { Object.defineProperty(values, 'length', { writable: false }); }
assign(Object.freeze, 4, false);
assign(readonlyLength, 1, false);
assign(readonlyLength, 2, false);
assign(readonlyLength, 2, true);
